limits_note: The token is the failure surface: 'The token will be valid until the next connection attempt' and an obsolete one returns 'Token error, please log-in' at the debrid-link call rather than at authentication.
binding_note: One token per account and a new login invalidates the old one, so the first thing that breaks a 1 TiB/month automation is a second client or a restart that logs in again; the 50 req/s ban is far above a download client's call rate.

identity_cost.detail: Email validation is the activation step ('Mega-Debrid commence la prestation à compter de la validation de l'adresse email'); card or Allopass/Rentabiliweb code to pay.

reliability_note: A second login silently invalidates the running session's token; four bad logins or more than 50 requests a second ban the IP for minutes; a free account is indistinguishable from a broken one until the token call returns vip_end.
confidence_note: The API behaviour, the token rule and both ban conditions are on the vendor's own API page. Prices and per-plan traffic are not published on the pages read, so they are absent rather than guessed.

notes: Candidates for the first failure: token invalidation, the free-account vip_end, or an IP ban. Token invalidation is the only one that hits an otherwise healthy paid account, and it is documented as a property of the token, not an error. The conditions page is French-only in content even on the lang=en URL, so the quota clauses are quoted in the original. Two vendor findings worth carrying: the API is premium-only by design, and authentication is credential-based with a token that dies on re-login. That combination makes it the worst of the eight for an unattended script, independent of price. Abandonment condition: if a key-based auth appears, re-read the page the same day. The hosters page (/index.php?page=hebergeurs) is marketing only - '100 Hosters supported' and four logos - while the cap table lives on the registration page, where nobody looking for limits would think to go. Three host counts from one vendor: 100 on the offers page, 'over 200 hosts' in the meta description, 85 rows in the hosters table. The 85 is what a reader can count, so it is the figure to use. No annual plan: the ladder stops at 180 days for 16 EUR. A French proxy with a contract written for a traffic-limited subscription. Nothing in it promises a file will be there tomorrow. Abandonment condition: if a tariff or FAQ page states a cloud or a retention window, this record needs a second entry. Same pattern as Debrid-Link, less severe: price identical to the euro for 35 months, host count down 162 -> 161 -> 152 -> 100, a 38% loss. The service is the cheapest 30-day term in the set alongside Debrid-Link and the least observed. Classified card-or-PayPal in the matrix because the vendor's own rail list could not be read and every reseller listing leads with card or PayPal the Bitcoin leg exists at resellers and is recorded here rather than counted in the crypto group. Included as the Spanish-language breadth point, not as a recommendation: found no Latin American operator of a full multi-host. Every Spanish or Portuguese storefront read here resolves to a European operator (AllDebrid, MultiDebrid, Mega-Debrid) or to a Brazilian reseller of somebody else's accounts.

extras.account_states: vip_end (free or lapsed); 'Token error, please log-in' (session replaced); IP banned for minutes (4 bad logins or >50 req/s); expired premium
extras.cache_miss: no cache-status endpoint in the API page read; getTorrent returns status and progress only
extras.host_removal: hosters are enumerated per request by getHostersList with a status field, which is a live list rather than an announcement
extras.simultaneous_use: No multi-IP rule on the API or conditions pages read. The token is single-session by construction and is the effective limit: a second login invalidates the first client's token.
extras.auth_flows: one: action=connectUser&login=&password= in the query string, returning 'token' plus 'vip_end' (premium expiry timestamp). No key, no OAuth, no refresh.
